items.exampleEn: The police found fake money in his bag.
items.exampleZh: 警方在他的包包裡發現了假鈔。

items.exampleEn: This brave act is worthy of praise.
items.exampleZh: 這個勇敢的行為值得稱讚。

items.exampleEn: The shiny coins caught the baby's eye.
items.exampleZh: 那些閃亮的硬幣吸引了寶寶的目光。

items.exampleEn: The teacher spoke positively about my essay.
items.exampleZh: 老師正面地評論了我的作文。

items.exampleEn: Your writing is unclear in some places.
items.exampleZh: 你的文章有些地方寫得不清楚。

items.exampleEn: Nobody had cleaned the dusty room for years.
items.exampleZh: 那個滿是灰塵的房間好幾年沒人打掃了。

items.exampleEn: The scientists did a systematic study of the river.
items.exampleZh: 科學家們對這條河進行了有系統的研究。

items.exampleEn: We had gorgeous weather on our trip.
items.exampleZh: 我們旅行時天氣美極了。

items.sentenceEn: The road was hot and dusty.
items.sentenceZh: 那條路又熱又滿是灰塵。

items.audioEn: Don't buy that watch. It looks shiny and new, but it's fake.
items.audioZh: 別買那支錶。它看起來閃亮又新，但其實是假的。
items.questionZh: 說話者為什麼叫對方別買？
options: The watch is much too expensive.

items.sentenceEn: She keeps her notes in a systematic way.
items.sentenceZh: 她用有系統的方式整理筆記。

items.sentenceEn: The reason for the delay is still unclear.
items.sentenceZh: 延誤的原因仍然不清楚。

items.stemEn: Her ____ black hair shone in the sun.
items.stemZh: 她烏黑亮麗的頭髮在陽光下發亮。

items.stemEn: Most people reacted ____ to the new park.
items.stemZh: 大多數人對新公園的反應都很正面。

items.passageEn: Last weekend, I helped my grandma clean her garage. Everything was dusty. We worked in a systematic way: first the boxes, then the shelves. In one box, we found a shiny old ring. Grandma said it might be fake, but she wasn't sure; it was unclear where it came from. We also found a gorgeous old dress that Grandma wore when she was young. She said it was worthy of a museum! To her, every old thing is precious. Grandma always thinks positively, so she laughed even when a box fell on her foot.
items.passageZh: 上週末，我幫奶奶打掃她的車庫。所有東西都滿是灰塵。我們有系統地工作：先整理箱子，再整理架子。在一個箱子裡，我們發現了一枚閃亮的舊戒指。奶奶說它可能是假的，但她不確定，因為不清楚它是從哪裡來的。我們還找到一件奶奶年輕時穿過、美極了的舊洋裝。她說這件洋裝值得放進博物館！對她來說，每樣舊東西都很珍貴。奶奶總是很積極地看待事情，所以連箱子掉到她腳上時，她都笑了。

options: 請好幾位鄰居一起來幫忙打掃
把所有東西都搬到院子裡曬太陽
先整理箱子，再整理架子
一邊聽音樂一邊慢慢地打掃

questions.questionZh: 奶奶對那件舊洋裝說了什麼？

referenceEn: I think this painting is fake.
I believe this painting is fake.
rubricZh: fake 表示「假的」，例如 fake money 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 gorgeous 造一個句子，描述你見過最美的東西或地方。
referenceEn: The beach near my grandma's house is gorgeous.
I saw a gorgeous sunset last summer.
rubricZh: gorgeous 表示「極美的」，例如 a gorgeous view 等說法
說的是自己的經驗（例如 I、my）
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式或過去式等）
